conclusion: All 10 failures in the current four-suite audit reproduce with identical failure signatures on an isolated archive of HEAD. They are pre-existing, not regressions caused by Harbor boat, water or map changes.
auditScope: Targeted re-run of the four failing suites (35 tests), not a replacement for the parent full-server-suite report.

observations: RoleAssigner uses fixed count tiers and ignores huntersPerPlayers; unchanged tests expect floor division. Both count assertions fail on HEAD.
ScoringSystem awards survival points per 2-second tick; unchanged tests expect points each second. This explains four ScoringSystem failures and two GameplayFlow score failures.
MatchStateMachine retains ACTIVE when fewer than two players remain; unchanged GameplayFlow test expects immediate ROUND_END after disconnect.
MatchStateMachine.resetToWaiting calls setMetadata; unchanged mock factory has no setMetadata, causing the same TypeError on HEAD.

The unseeded 20-round fairness test additionally failed in the first HEAD run (maxDiff 9 > 8), but passed in the current run. Its source uses Math.random without a test seed; no attempt was made to alter randomness or force a pass.

sharedConstants.difference: Working changes only add WATER_DROWN_GRACE_MS, WATER_SURFACE_Y, WATER_SWIM_FEET_Y and WATER_SWIM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER plus comments. Existing role/scoring constants are unchanged. Isolated runs use the original HEAD constants.
